selectionNotes: Four concise examples per country; gameplay selects from every reviewed eligible alternative. Availability is rechecked against the saved round exclusions. Every Medium/Hard hint must leave at least seven declared possible answers, including conservative extras, and at least four confirmed matches. A partial positive list is not an exhaustive shortlist.

notes: FAO Pacific coastal-country review lists the first set explicitly, supplemented by the UN Pacific island-country list. Includes marginal Pacific seas as classified by FAO. This is a conservative verified membership list, not an exhaustive list of every Pacific coast.

OSPAR Table1 explicitly identifies North Sea coastal areas for Belgium, Denmark, Germany, Netherlands, Norway and UK; France borders its southern entrance in the Dover Strait. Sweden is excluded because OSPAR lists only Kattegat/Skagerrak coasts; Greater North Sea would include it.
Sweden only fits the broader Greater North Sea convention, included as a fairness upper-bound possibility but not assigned the plain North Sea clue.

Conservative verified list: CMS Atlantic Coast of Africa treaty range states, OSPAR Atlantic coastal areas, FAO Argentina/Brazil/Uruguay coastal list and FAO Cuba profile. Atlantic marginal seas are excluded unless the country also has a direct Atlantic coast.

possibleExtraCodes conservatively lists unassigned countries that may satisfy Atlantic coast under direct or marginal-sea conventions; use them only for fairness upper bounds, not as sourced assignments.

The upper bound includes all reviewed North Sea, Baltic, Mediterranean and Black Sea coastal sets, plus Denmark and Netherlands overseas Atlantic scopes. These are conservative possibilities, not new assignments of the direct Atlantic clue.

catalog.text: Has at least three land neighbours and a sea coast.
notes: Plain conjunction: at least three distinct sovereign natural land neighbours, plus a coast on a sea. Connected ocean seas and the named inland Caspian Sea qualify. No exact total, artificial causeway count or maritime boundary is asserted.

Confirmed seed: existing validated coastal at-least-three neighbour records. India and Pakistan are separate official-profile robust lower bounds; their exact disputed totals remain suppressed in the records.

India witnesses Bangladesh, Bhutan and Nepal; Pakistan witnesses India, Iran and Afghanistan. The official profiles also confirm sea coasts. Claimed Afghanistan–India adjacency and the disputed China–Pakistan boundary are not needed to prove these lower bounds.

Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan and Turkmenistan are added because UNEP explicitly identifies them as Caspian littoral states, and their existing verified neighbour records establish at least three. Landlocked status does not mean absence of a sea coast.

Scope-ambiguous countries with a genuinely possible >=3 total are included only in possibleExtraCodes. Denmark has at most two under the documented natural sovereign-border scope; Bahrain, Singapore, Cuba and Cyprus remain below three under their documented possible scopes and are omitted from upper bounds.
Uzbekistan is possible-extra-only for the remaining Aral Sea shore, so the literal sea-coast interpretation cannot silently understate breadth.

Jordan promoted from possible-extra-only to confirmed after independent official-profile reads: the Gulf of Aqaba coast and land neighbours Saudi Arabia, Iraq and Syria establish the conjunction. No Israel/Palestine convention, maritime Egypt border, coast length or exact neighbour total is used.
Union of the verified UN M49 Southern Asia and Western Asia memberships. The wording accommodates the everyday West Asia classification of Iran.
